name: File Explorer Plugin
description: Recursive file tree browser displayed in the left split pane of ExplorerPlugin. Renders a nested directory tree with color-coded file names by extension, expandable/collapsible directories, inline file/folder creation via input field, inline rename, delete with ConfirmModal, copy-paste across directories, and context menus on files and empty areas. Watches for external file changes to auto-refresh the tree. Supports selecting a file and revealing it in the tree via selectFile().

dependencies.usage: Opens right-click context menus on files (open/rename/delete/copy path/open in markdown) and empty area (new file/folder/paste)
Prompts confirmation before deleting files or directories

methods.name: constructor
methods.signature: (container: HTMLElement, rootPath: string, onFileOpen: (path: string) => void)
methods.description: Builds tree header and scrollable container, loads root directory, watches file changes

methods.name: selectFile
methods.description: Expands parent directories and highlights the given file

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Clears and reloads the entire file tree from disk

methods.name: setMarkdownOpeners
methods.signature: (labels: string[], callback: (filePath: string, label: string) => void): void
methods.description: Registers right-click 'Open in Markdown' menu items
